title: Sherpa-UI entity library
description: The preset entities of an app, by id: each an entity.v3 envelope, read only; and the types they are of, each a type.v1 by id. App.v1 `entities` names the file. docs/history/plan-746-entities-and-graph-views.md, plan 960 U2
